## 02. Data Analysis

```{r}
library(corrplot)
library(survey)
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
```

# Functions

```{r}
# Define function for model formulas
model_formula <- function(pfas, outcome) {
  as.formula(
    paste0(outcome, " ~ ", pfas, " + Age + factor(Sex) + factor(Race_Ethnicity) + Income_Ratio + log2_Cotinine"))}
```

```{r}
# Define function for sex-stratified model formula
model_formula_nosex <- function(pfas, outcome) {
  as.formula(
    paste0(outcome, " ~ ", pfas, " + Age + factor(Race_Ethnicity) + Income_Ratio + log2_Cotinine"))}
```

```{r}
# Define function for p-value formatting (Table 2)
fmt_p <- function(x) ifelse(x < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", x))
```

```{r}
# Define function to run PFAS models 
run_pfas_models <- function(design_object, label = NA) {
  results <- list()
  
  # Loop pfas and outcome variables into model form
  for (outcome in outcome_vars) {
    for (pfas in pfas_vars) {
      
      # Fit survey-weighted model for each PFAS x outcome
      fit <- svyglm(
        model_formula(pfas, outcome),
        design = design_object)
      
      # Convert results to a dataframe and append to my_results
      model_df <- tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
        filter(term == pfas) %>%                       # Extract the coefficient for PFAS
        mutate(                                        # Add new columns with PFAS/outcome
          Outcome = outcome,
          PFAS = pfas,
          Group = label)
      
      results[[length(results) + 1]] <- model_df}}
   bind_rows(results)}
```

```{r}
# Define function to run sex-stratified PFAS models
run_pfas_models_nosex <- function(design_object, label = NA) {
  results_nosex <- list()
  
  # Loop pfas and outcome variables into model form
  for (outcome in outcome_vars) {
    for (pfas in pfas_vars) {
      
      # Fit survey-weighted model for each PFAS x outcome
      fit <- svyglm(
        model_formula_nosex(pfas, outcome),
        design = design_object)
      
      # Convert results to a dataframe and append to results_nosex
      model_df <- tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
        filter(term == pfas) %>%
        mutate(
          Outcome = outcome,
          PFAS = pfas,
          Group = label)
      
      results_nosex[[length(results_nosex) + 1]] <- model_df}}
  bind_rows(results_nosex)}
```

```{r}
# Define function for multi-PFAS model formula
model_formula_multi <- function(outcome) {
  as.formula(
    paste0(outcome,
           " ~ log2_PFOA + log2_PFOS + log2_PFNA + log2_PFHxS",
           " + Age + factor(Sex) + factor(Race_Ethnicity)",
           " + Income_Ratio + log2_Cotinine"))}
```

```{r}
# Run mutually adjusted PFAS models
run_multi_pfas_models <- function(design_object, label = NA) {
  
  results <- list()
  
  for (outcome in outcome_vars) {
    
    fit <- svyglm(
      model_formula_multi(outcome),
      design = design_object)
    
    model_df <- tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
      filter(term %in% c("log2_PFOA", "log2_PFOS",
                         "log2_PFNA", "log2_PFHxS")) %>%
      mutate(
        Outcome = outcome,
        PFAS = term,
        Group = label)
    
    results[[length(results) + 1]] <- model_df}
  
  bind_rows(results)}
```


# A. Correlation Matrix

```{r}
# Relabel log transformed vars
pfas_corr <- nhanes_transformed %>% select(log2_PFOA, log2_PFOS, log2_PFNA, log2_PFHxS) %>%
                                    rename(PFOA = log2_PFOA,
                                           PFOS = log2_PFOS,
                                           PFNA = log2_PFNA,
                                           PFHxS = log2_PFHxS)
# Create matrix
pfas_matrix <- cor(pfas_corr)

# Choose colors for correlogram 
col <- colorRampPalette(c("#BB4444", "#EE9988", "#FFFFFF", "#77AADD", "#4477AA"))

# Create correlogram
pfas_correlogram <- corrplot(pfas_matrix, method = "color", type = "upper", addCoef.col = "Black", col=col(200), tl.col="black", tl.srt=0)
pfas_correlogram
```
# B. Table 2: PFAS - Biomarker Associations 

```{r}
# Specify PFAS and outcomes
pfas_vars <- c("log2_PFOA", "log2_PFOS", "log2_PFNA", "log2_PFHxS")
outcome_vars <- c("log2_CRP", "log2_WBC", "Neutrophils", "Lymphocytes") 
```

```{r}
# Run overall model
tbl2_raw <- run_pfas_models(                     # Use linear model function
  design_object = nhanes_design,
  label = "Overall") %>%
  mutate(
    q_value = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"),   # FDR correction for multiple testing
    beta_ci = sprintf(
      "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",                         # Round to 2 decimal places 
      estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
    p_value = fmt_p(p.value),                      # Format p and q-values
    q_value = fmt_p(q_value))
```
  
```{r}
# Order variables for table 2
tbl2_clean <- tbl2_raw %>% mutate(
  Outcome = factor(
      Outcome,
      levels = c("log2_CRP", "log2_WBC", "Lymphocytes", "Neutrophils"),
      labels = c("C-reactive protein (mg/L)", "White blood cell count (10⁹/L)", "Lymphocytes (%)", "Neutrophils (%)")),
    PFAS = factor(
      PFAS,
      levels = c("log2_PFOA", "log2_PFOS", "log2_PFNA", "log2_PFHxS"),
      labels = c("PFOA", "PFOS", "PFNA", "PFHxS")))
```

```{r}
# Select and rename variables for table
tbl2_final <- tbl2_clean %>%
  select(Outcome, PFAS, beta_ci, p_value, q_value) %>%
  rename(
    "Immune Biomarker" = Outcome,
    "PFAS Compound" = PFAS,
    "β (95% CI)" = beta_ci,
    "p-value" = p_value,
    "q-value" = q_value)
```

```{r}
# Formatted table 2
tbl2 <- tbl2_final %>%
  kbl(
    caption = "Table 2. Associations between PFAS compounds and immune biomarkers, NHANES 2015–2018.",
    align = c("l", "l", "c", "c", "c"),
    booktabs = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center") %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>%
  footnote(general =
      "Values represent β coefficients (95% CI) from survey-weighted linear regression models. PFAS concentrations, C-reactive protein (CRP), and white blood cell (WBC) count were log₂-transformed prior to analysis, while lymphocyte and neutrophil percentages were modeled on the original scale. β coefficients for PFAS represent the change in the immune biomarker associated with a doubling of PFAS concentration. For CRP and WBC, coefficients represent percent change in the outcome per doubling of PFAS; for neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages, coefficients represent absolute percentage-point change per doubling of PFAS. All models were adjusted for age, sex, race/ethnicity, income-to-poverty ratio, and log₂-transformed serum cotinine. q-values were calculated using the Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate procedure. Abbreviations: PFAS, per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances; PFOA, perfluorooctanoic acid; PFOS, perfluorooctane sulfonate; PFNA, perfluorononanoic acid; PFHxS, perfluorohexane sulfonate.")
tbl2

```

```{r}
# Save tbl2 as .png file
save_kable(tbl2, file = "outputs/Table2_NHANES_2015_2018.png", zoom = 10)
```

```{r, message = F}
# F. Figure 1: Forest Plots (2x2 panel, horizontal, centered at 0)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

# Prep data
plot_data <- tbl2_raw %>%
  mutate(
    PFAS = recode(PFAS,
      "log2_PFOA" = "PFOA",
      "log2_PFOS" = "PFOS",
      "log2_PFNA" = "PFNA",
      "log2_PFHxS" = "PFHxS"),
    PFAS = factor(PFAS, levels = c("PFOA","PFOS","PFNA","PFHxS"))
  )

# Split + transform
crp_plot <- plot_data %>%
  filter(Outcome == "log2_CRP") %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = (2^estimate - 1) * 100,
    conf.low = (2^conf.low - 1) * 100,
    conf.high = (2^conf.high - 1) * 100
  )

wbc_plot <- plot_data %>%
  filter(Outcome == "log2_WBC") %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = (2^estimate - 1) * 100,
    conf.low = (2^conf.low - 1) * 100,
    conf.high = (2^conf.high - 1) * 100
  )

lymph_plot <- plot_data %>% filter(Outcome == "Lymphocytes")
neut_plot  <- plot_data %>% filter(Outcome == "Neutrophils")

# Plot function (centered at 0 per panel)
make_plot <- function(data, title, xlab) {
  
  max_abs <- max(abs(c(data$conf.low, data$conf.high)), na.rm = TRUE)
  limits <- c(-max_abs, max_abs)
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = estimate, y = PFAS)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = p.value < 0.05), size = 3) +
scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "gray60", "TRUE" = "#002366")) +
guides(color = "none") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high, color = p.value < 0.05),
               height = 0.2) +
   geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "gray40") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = limits) +
    labs(title = title, x = xlab, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank() 
    )
}

# Create plots
p1 <- make_plot(crp_plot,  "A. C-reactive protein", "Percent change per doubling of PFAS")
p2 <- make_plot(wbc_plot,  "B. White blood cell count", "Percent change per doubling of PFAS")
p3 <- make_plot(lymph_plot,"C. Lymphocytes", "Percentage-point change per doubling of PFAS")
p4 <- make_plot(neut_plot, "D. Neutrophils", "Percentage-point change per doubling of PFAS")

# Combine into 2x2 panel
forest <- (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1), heights = c(1, 1)) &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10))
forest
```
```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "outputs/Figure1_ForestPlots.png",
  plot = forest,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)
```


# C. Table 3: Age-Stratified PFAS - Biomarker Associations

```{r}
# Subset survey design object by age group
nhanes_design_adolescents <- subset(nhanes_design,
  AgeGroup == "Adolescents (12–17)")

nhanes_design_adults <- subset(nhanes_design,
  AgeGroup == "Adults (≥18)")
```

```{r}
# Run age-stratified models using model function
table3_raw <- bind_rows(
  run_pfas_models(nhanes_design_adolescents, "Adolescents (12–17)"),
  run_pfas_models(nhanes_design_adults, "Adults (≥18)"))
```

```{r}
# Collect model results and format
tbl3_fmt <- table3_raw %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%                           # Conduct FDR within age group  
  mutate(
    q_value = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"),     
    beta_ci = sprintf(
      "%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)",
      estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
    p_value = fmt_p(p.value),
    q_value = fmt_p(q_value)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# Order and label variables for Table 3
tbl3_clean <- tbl3_fmt %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome = factor(
      Outcome,
      levels = c("log2_CRP", "log2_WBC", "Lymphocytes", "Neutrophils"),
      labels = c("C-reactive protein (mg/L)", "White blood cell count (10⁹/L)", "Lymphocytes (%)","Neutrophils (%)")),
    PFAS = factor(
      PFAS,
      levels = c("log2_PFOA", "log2_PFOS", "log2_PFNA", "log2_PFHxS"),
      labels = c("PFOA", "PFOS", "PFNA", "PFHxS")),
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = c("Adolescents (12–17)", "Adults (≥18)")))
```

```{r}
# Select and rename variables for Table 3
tbl3_final <- tbl3_clean %>%
  select(Group, Outcome, PFAS, beta_ci, p_value, q_value) %>%
  rename(
    "Age Group" = Group,
    "Immune Biomarker" = Outcome,
    "PFAS Compound" = PFAS,
    "β (95% CI)" = beta_ci,
    "p-value" = p_value,
    "q-value" = q_value)
```

```{r}
tbl3_side <- tbl3_clean %>%
  select(Group, Outcome, PFAS, beta_ci, p_value, q_value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Group,
    values_from = c(beta_ci, p_value, q_value),
    names_glue = "{Group}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    `Immune Biomarker` = Outcome,
    `PFAS Compound`   = PFAS,

    # Adolescents block
    `β (95% CI)` = `Adolescents (12–17)_beta_ci`,
    `p-value`          = `Adolescents (12–17)_p_value`,
    `q-value`          = `Adolescents (12–17)_q_value`,

    # Adults block
    `β (95% CI) ` = `Adults (≥18)_beta_ci`,  # space forces uniqueness
    `p-value `          = `Adults (≥18)_p_value`,
    `q-value `          = `Adults (≥18)_q_value`
  )
```

```{r}
tbl3c <- tbl3_side %>%
  kbl(
    caption = "Table 3. Age-stratified associations between PFAS compounds and immune biomarkers, NHANES 2015–2018.",
    align = c("l","l","c","c","c","c","c","c"),
    booktabs = TRUE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
  add_header_above(
    c(" " = 2,
      "Adolescents (12–17 years) (N = 455)" = 3,
      "Adults (≥18 years) (N = 2,999)" = 3)
  ) %>%
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>%
  footnote(
    general =
      "Values represent β coefficients (95% CI) from survey-weighted linear regression models. PFAS concentrations, C-reactive protein (CRP), and white blood cell (WBC) count were log₂-transformed prior to analysis, while lymphocyte and neutrophil percentages were modeled on the original scale. β coefficients for PFAS represent the change in the immune biomarker associated with a doubling of PFAS concentration. For CRP and WBC, coefficients represent percent change in the outcome per doubling of PFAS; for neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages, coefficients represent absolute percentage-point change per doubling of PFAS. All models were adjusted for age (continuous), sex, race/ethnicity, income-to-poverty ratio, and log₂-transformed serum cotinine. q-values were calculated using the Benjamini–Hochberg false discovery rate procedure. Abbreviations: PFAS, per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances; PFOA, perfluorooctanoic acid; PFOS, perfluorooctane sulfonate; PFNA, perfluorononanoic acid; PFHxS, perfluorohexane sulfonate.")
tbl3c
```


```{r}
# Save tbl3
save_kable(tbl3c, file = "outputs/Table3_NHANES_2015_2018.png", zoom = 2)
```

```{r}
model_age_int <- svyglm(
  log2_CRP ~ log2_PFOA * AgeGroup +
    Age + factor(Sex) + factor(Race_Ethnicity) +
    Income_Ratio + log2_Cotinine,
  design = nhanes_design
)

regTermTest(model_age_int, ~ log2_PFOA:AgeGroup)
```
```{r}
model_sex_int <- svyglm(
  log2_CRP ~ log2_PFOA * factor(Sex) +
    Age + factor(Race_Ethnicity) +
    Income_Ratio + log2_Cotinine,
  design = nhanes_design
)
regTermTest(model_sex_int, ~ log2_PFOA:factor(Sex))
```

```{r}
test_interaction <- function(pfas, outcome, modifier) {
  
  formula_int <- as.formula(
    paste0(outcome, " ~ ", pfas, " * ", modifier,
           " + Age + factor(Sex) + factor(Race_Ethnicity)",
           " + Income_Ratio + log2_Cotinine")
  )
  
  fit <- svyglm(formula_int, design = nhanes_design)
  
  regTermTest(fit, as.formula(paste0("~", pfas, ":", modifier)))
}

test_interaction("log2_PFOA", "log2_CRP", "AgeGroup")
test_interaction("log2_PFOS", "log2_WBC", "factor(Sex)")
```
